'''October 2000 Bountiful tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at End Zone Comics, Bountiful, Utah on 21 October 2000. [[Jason Ayre]] won it. It is known from Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1382">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-end-zone-comics-bountiful-utah-10-21-2d1382/ end-zone-comics-bountiful-utah-10-21-2], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-end-zone-comics-bountiful-utah-10-21-2d1382/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' End Zone Comics, Bountiful, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Ayre]]
